responsibility: Implements canonicalization for next-trait-solver queries by folding types, regions, and consts into canonical variables, deduplicating repeated occurrences, tracking variable and universe metadata, and producing canonical inputs and responses with the universe remapping needed for query caching and cross-query result reuse. It is responsible for canonicalizing error regions in query inputs, including `ReError`, so next-solver and coherence queries containing already-reported lifetime errors still receive stable, unique canonical variables instead of reusing raw error regions across solver evaluations.
